title: Define bit-channel metadata and demapper analysis modes
description:
Define how the modem framework represents bit positions within a symbol for analysis, and make demapper semantics explicit for analytical and empirical tooling.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The modem API exposes bit-position or bit-channel identity for supported constellations.
- [ ] Analysis-facing demapper mode selection is explicit, including supported exact and approximate LLR semantics.
- [ ] Normalization and noise-parameter assumptions needed for analysis are documented in the API contract.

## Notes

This task should extend the shared modem API rather than introducing a parallel analysis-only modem surface.
